episodes.summary: Day 1: homeless and broke, Leo sleeps on a train platform with only a backpack (blanket, broken phone, an old photo of him with a smiling girl). He promises to become the richest man in the world. He earns $8 washing windshields at red lights, then discovers he is great at repairing phones and sells his first one for $20. Then a man in a black car offers him $500 cash to unlock 20 phones tonight, no questions asked. Cash: $28.
